title: AgentTrust Power Analysis

results.interpretation: With 15 payloads per category, we can detect a difference of ~34.3pp in ASR with 80% power.

implications: True ASR difference ≥ 34pp → We WILL detect it statistically
True ASR difference < 34pp → We likely WON'T detect it (Type II error)
This is acceptable. Smaller effects require larger n (more payloads).
Current n=15 per category is a good balance: fast experiments + detectable effects.
